subject: ACE enablement ops playbook / PDM & PSM handshake for Acme Logistics
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@acmelogistics.com>
Cc: Rajiv Kumar <rajiv_kumar@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ACE enablement ops playbook / PDM & PSM handshake for Acme Logistics

Hi Emily,

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday — excited about the potential to run Redwood Inference for Acme's routing optimization pilots. Per our ask, I’m starting the ACE registration thread and copying Rajiv (AWS PDM) to help with the co-sell intake.

Attached is a brief ACE checklist (ace_checklist.pdf) with the high-level items AWS will want for registration and co-sell validation. Quick summary of asks from our side: 
- Confirm primary POC for procurement and security (email below)
- Share a short mutual action plan (I attached a starter MAP)
- Confirm sandbox sizing and target go-live window (we discussed Nov -> Dec pilot)

Next steps: if Rajiv can confirm the PDM/PSM pairing and any additional intake fields, we’ll submit the ACE intake from our workspace. Emily, can you confirm who on Acme’s side will own procurement and a preferred NDA cadence?

Thanks — I’ll coordinate internal alignment once Rajiv confirms.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 (555) 212-0006
Redwood Inference — Inference you can ship

Attachments: ace_checklist.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
From: Rajiv Kumar <rajiv_kumar@amazon.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Emily Chen <emily.chen@acmelogistics.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Team <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACE enablement ops playbook / PDM & PSM handshake for Acme Logistics

Hi Jasmine / Emily —

Thanks for the intro, Jasmine. Happy to help with the ACE intake. For PDM/PSM assignment: I’ve provisionally looped in our regional PDM (Priya Joshi) and PSM (Tom Alvarez). They’ll review the attached checklist and help validate the co-sell profile.

Rajiv notes:
- ACE intake will need a short description of the use case (routing optimization pilot), estimated ARR range (please provide a close estimate), and whether customer wants to pursue co-sell enablement or marketplace listing first.
- If Acme can commit to a pilot window (start date + 6-8 week pilot), that speeds approval.

Emily — can you confirm the procurement contact and an initial ARR estimate? I’ll take the intake through ACE once we have those fields.

Regards,
Rajiv Kumar
Sr Partner Development Manager, AWS
rajiv_kumar@amazon.com

--- Forwarded message ---
From: AWS Marketplace Team <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
To: Rajiv Kumar <rajiv_kumar@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 11:06:00 -07:00
Subject: ACE intake link

Please use the intake form: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/ace-intake
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: ACE enablement ops playbook / PDM & PSM handshake for Acme Logistics

Team —

Forwarding Rajiv’s response. A few tactical notes before I reply to Acme: 
1) Pricing posture: Emily is sensitive to predictable unit pricing; propose a pilot credit + committed discount for first 12 months. Marcus — can you draft a one-page pilot pricing (baseline qps / token estimate + credit)?
2) Technical: Acme expects a sandbox capable of ~8k tokens/session and 10 concurrent sessions during the pilot. Priyom — validate whether our Dedicated pool projection fits that; if not, outline options (burst capacity vs scaled dedicated).
3) Co-sell timing: Rajiv asked ARR range — our ask to Acme should be to give a conservative estimate ($50k-$250k) so AWS can classify.

I’ll keep the language simple to avoid scaring procurement. Final: I plan to send a consolidated reply to Emily + Rajiv with proposed pilot pricing + adjusted MAP by EOD Thu.

Thanks,
Jasmine

--
Internal notes: Marcus, Priyom, please put draft files in the shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-acme-ace
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@acmelogistics.com>, Rajiv Kumar <rajiv_kumar@amazon.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acmelogistics.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Oct 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACE enablement ops playbook / PDM & PSM handshake for Acme Logistics

Hi Emily / Rajiv —

Quick update and a compact mutual action plan so we can move the ACE intake forward:

Mutual action plan (summary):
- Acme to confirm procurement POC: procurement@acmelogistics.com (confirmed) — due: Mon 11/1
- Acme to provide conservative ARR estimate (range) — due: Mon 11/1
- Redwood to share pilot pricing + credits (draft attached: acme_mutual_action_plan.xlsx) — due: Thu 11/4
- AWS to submit ACE intake once procurement + ARR range are provided — Rajiv to confirm timing
- Technical kickoff: target pilot start 11/15, 6–8 week pilot window, sandbox sizing validated by Redwood

Attachments: acme_mutual_action_plan.xlsx (Excel, 1 sheet)

If that looks good I’ll prepare the ACE intake and submit it to Rajiv and the AWS Marketplace team. Let me know if you want a quick 20-min sync to walk through the MAP.

Thanks everyone — appreciative of the quick turnaround.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 (555) 212-0006

Sign-off: If AWS needs any additional enterprise procurement artifacts (SOC2, ISO) let me know and I’ll attach them to the intake.
